source_text.body:
Refine outreach copy and decide whether to send
An agentic workflow refines sales copy through multiple stages, and a final agent reviews the draft and decides to send, defer or disqualify.
·
Jul 1, 2025
Done with a
custom-built or unnamed agent
What they did
The poster described a planned outreach system, not a completed build. Their manual cold outreach already gets over a 10% reply rate, and they wanted to automate it with a scraper built as a CLI plus a browser extension using native messaging, then a three-stage agent pipeline: one agent generates drafts while another, role-playing the prospect, iterates on them; a second agent checks facts and formatting; a final agent decides go, defer, or disqualify.
How it went
No implementation results were shared in the thread. The only stated benchmark was the poster’s existing manual process at over a 10% reply rate, and the lone comment just said the commenter sent a DM.
Worth knowing
The clearest constraint was budget: they said up to $1 per outreach would be acceptable for a few thousand prospects.
Try it yourself
with
Claude
Copy prompt
Here is my draft outreach to [prospect] along with their background: [paste]. Refine the copy in three passes (clarity, personalization, call to action), then act as a final reviewer and recommend whether I should send, defer, or disqualify this lead, with reasons. Show me the final draft and your recommendation without sending anything.
Original source: https://www.reddit.com/r/SaaS/comments/1msku4e
